title: BEST SKYLINE Nashville MODERN Home. 5 min to DT
description:
LUXURY | MODERN | SINGLE FAMILY HOME | BEST DOWNTOWN SKYLINE VIEWS | HUGE DECK & ENTERTAINING AREA | SMART TV

Welcome to our beautiful vacation house near downtown Nashville! This is a great place for family and friends. It is conveniently located just 5 – 10 minutes Uber drive away from all the popular spots on Broadway, Downtown, the Five Points.

The space
•	Easy self-check-in with keyless entry
•	6 parking space
•	3 bedrooms (with 7 beds and 2 sleeper sofa)
•	3 full bathrooms
•	3200 ft2 (297 m2)
•	Huge deck with best skyline view in Nashville
•	2 Smart TV with free Sling, Netflix, YouTube
•	High-speed internet throughout the house and a mesh WIFI system.
•	Central heat & AC
•	Onsite washer + dryer
•	Fully equipped + stocked kitchen w/ Keurig
•	Extremely safe neighborhood

1st Floor: 1 Bonus Room
2nd Floor: 1 Bedroom (2 queens), Living Room (1 smart TV, 1 sleeper sofa), 1 Full Bathroom, Kitchen, Deck, Laundry Room
3rd Floor: 1 Bedroom (1 king, 1 sleeper sofa, 1 smart TV), 1 Bedroom (1 queen, 1 full-size), 2 Full Bathroom, 1 Office Space

Guest Access

ENTIRE SPACE:
Entire space is included in this rental. Please, make yourself at home.

KEYLESS ENTRY:
Prior to your arrival, you will receive a unique keypad code that will serve as your keyless entry to the home during your stay.

GUIDE BOOK:
A book with recommendations for local restaurants, coffee shops, local attractions and other places to visit is provided in the home.

Other Things to Note

PLEASE TREAT THE SPACE WITH RESPECT! If any problems arise, we will do our best to take action ASAP.

PLEASE BE A GREAT NEIGHBOR! Please be respectful to our neighbors and keep interior and exterior noise to a respectable level at all times. Any noise complaints from neighbors may result in withholding of your deposit.
